note: M3.5 career/vacancy RESEARCH budget. Deliberately SEPARATE from data/pilot/pilot-budget.json, whose defaults.maxFetches:18 is the frozen production crawl budget and is NOT changed by M3.5. This file bounds a one-off live research pass whose only output is a source registry and an evidence database under data/pilot/. Bounds exist so the pilot proves the pipeline instead of becoming a crawler.

primary.note: The 29 CAREER_PAGE URLs located in pilot-sources.json. Each is fetched once, analysed, and recorded in the registry. This is the pass that decides each source's status.

detail.note: Same-host career sub-pages linked from the primary pages. Added after the primary pass showed that most institutions publish openings on a /careers sub-page rather than the located root, so a root-only pass cannot honestly conclude 'no current vacancy'. Capped per source so one site cannot consume the run.
